visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium close-up of a young woman with long, dark, wavy hair and meticulous makeup. She smiles warmly at the camera and uses her hands to frame her face, wearing a black top and a delicate silver necklace. The setting is a minimalist indoor space with bright, soft lighting against a plain white wall. (2) She holds up a smartphone displaying a lock screen with a portrait of another young woman featuring light-colored eyebrows. Her hair is clipped back with two silver hairpins on each side. She continues to speak with high energy, her facial expressions animated and engaging. (3) A scene transition shows an extreme close-up of her right eyebrow. She uses a triangular-tipped eyebrow pencil to fill in the brow area. Detailed text overlays describing the product and Step 1 of the tutorial appear at the top of the frame. (4) The close-up continues as she uses the sharper point of the pencil to draw fine, hair-like strokes, following the Step 2 instruction on screen. Her hand is steady, and the lighting clearly highlights the texture of the eyebrow hairs. (5) She then applies a tinted eyebrow mascara with a small wand, coating the hairs to lighten their color. Text overlays update to Step 3, focusing on achieving a specific "idol" look. (6) Returning to a medium shot, she holds the eyebrow pencil and mascara tube towards the camera, smiling and talking about their features. The brand name Maybelline is visible on the product packaging. (7) Close-up shots of the product's tip and her forearm follow. Her arm shows eight distinct brown swatches, labeled with text from BR-1 to BR-8 to showcase the variety of shades. (8) She demonstrates the product's durability by rubbing her forearm vigorously with her fingers. The swatches remain intact, showing no signs of smudging or fading under physical friction. (9) The video concludes with a split-screen comparison showing her "Before" eyebrows (thick and dark) and her "After" eyebrows (softer and lighter). She poses with the products, and promotional text regarding pricing and a calligraphy-style title appear to finish the tutorial.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-arousal, friendly female voice introducing the tutorial over an upbeat pop background track featuring a driving electronic drum beat and bright synthesizers. The voice is clear, centered, and exhibits professional broadcast clarity. (2) As the speaker transitions into discussing brow trends, the BGM remains steady with a consistent tempo. The speaker's intonation is dynamic, using rising contours to maintain audience engagement. There is no background noise, indicating a clean studio recording. (3) During the instructional phase, the vocal delivery becomes more rhythmic, mirroring the step-by-step nature of the tutorial. The music's percussive elements are prominent but sit comfortably below the clear vocal track in the mix. (4) Subtle digital sound effects accompany visual transitions between close-ups. The speaker maintains an enthusiastic tone, with occasional expressive peaks in pitch to highlight key product benefits, while the BGM provides a continuous energetic floor. (5) The final phase features a concluding promotional message with a slightly higher vocal dominance. The music continues without interruption until the end of the video, where it fades out smoothly alongside the speaker's final parting words.
